name: Shalby Ltd
title: Shalby Ltd - 540797 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Shalby's Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA rose 43% to INR37.4 crore on a 9.4% revenue gain, but standalone EBITDA fell and PAT was lifted mainly by a tax-regime change, not operations.

capex.quote: we do not see a large spending coming into the FY '27 and onwards

triggers.label: International revenue fell YoY
triggers.quote: the Middle East impacting our little off par operations

triggers.label: FY26 capex about INR160 crore; FY27 spend expected lower
triggers.quote: we do not see a large spending coming into the FY '27 and onwards

triggers.label: Franchise rollout slowed from 50-unit plan
triggers.quote: it seems like we may not be able to do it as aggressively as we had planned earlier

guidance.quote: we are looking at sustainable growth of minimum 15% as a CAGR
we are looking at somewhere close to INR600 crores to INR650 crores from a top line standpoint

guidance.value: not quantified; slower than earlier plan
guidance.quote: it seems like we may not be able to do it as aggressively as we had planned earlier

red_flags.label: PAT inflated by tax change
red_flags.quote: Our consolidated PAT stands at INR18.5 crores with a PAT margin of 6.2% as against loss of INR12.2 crores in the Q4 '25.

red_flags.label: Standalone EBITDA down YoY
red_flags.quote: Our standalone EBITDA stands at INR37.1 crores as against INR38 crores in Q4 '25.

red_flags.label: Gross margin fell ~90% to ~85%, unexplained
red_flags.quote: there has been a slight decrease by the reasons of the new doctors which we are recruiting

red_flags.label: Evasive on FY27 margin, debt and guidance
red_flags.quote: It would not be -- that we are restricted to comment on the numbers

red_flags.label: Borrowings rising; net debt INR446.2 crore group
red_flags.quote: with a net debt of INR446.2

red_flags.label: Implant business EBITDA only just positive
red_flags.quote: we still have some distance to go to get it into a double-digit EBITDA

evasions.topic: FY27/FY28 consolidated EBITDA margin and debt levels
evasions.quote: It would not be -- that we are restricted to comment on the numbers
by the restriction, we cannot comment on the timeline
So mostly, I have covered as to the measures which we have taken on various fronts
